Location: Sumter, SC

About SKF

SKF has been making the world spin since 1907! 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer dedicated to a culture of belonging, where our people flourish in an equitable environment that promotes leadership development and career growth. SKF bearings played an integral role in helping Mars Rover collect rock and regolith samples on the planet’s surface.

As an SKF team member, you will join 40,000 colleagues from more than 130 countries developing bearing technology and services that make rotation more reliable and sustainable. Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF aims to have net zero greenhouse gas emissions at all our production facilities by 2030.

SKF products keep vehicles rolling, power the machines that put food on your table, and even reach into the cosmos as part of the Mars rover mission. Founded in Sweden in 1907, today SKF is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Stockholm with annual sales in 2020 of approximately $10 billion.

Summary

Engineering Technicians are responsible for technical shop floor support. In this position, you will be the first line support in addressing daily production issues related to process performance. This position reports to an Engineering Supervisor.

Responsibilities Of The Engineering Tech May Include

Troubleshooting machining, programming and tooling issues.Special Process Support (NDT, HT and passivation, NADCAP, contamination).CMM programming & metrology support.Tool design.CAD/CAM support.Creation and updating of process documentation.Supporting New Product Introduction Activities.Supporting New Capital Introduction Activities.Other manufacturing engineering support as needed.

Job Duties

First line support in addressing daily production issues related to process performance.Trouble shooting machine, program and tooling issues.Support training and qualify new employees.Support Operations in meeting facility KPIs in Safety, Quality, Deliveries, and Cost.Support Channel Manufacturing Engineers in process documentation.Participate in problem solving and/or continuous improvement activities on various plant issues as assigned.Maintain 5S certification of work area and throughout the facilityPerforms data entry duties for a variety of manufacturing/quality systems.Support and recommends edits and updates of new and existing documents as assigned.Auditing operations to process standards.Creation of BOMs and routing documentation.Creation of manufacturing prints.CNC programming.

Required Skills And Education

3 years’ experience as an Engineering Tech I and an Associate in Science with an emphasis in machining, tool design, mechatonix, engineering, or 5 Years Manufacturing Experience.Proficient in MS Office Suite Software.Proficient in Solidworks.Proficient in CAD/CAM software (MasterCAM or hyperMill).Be able to lift and maneuver up to 35 lbs.Critical thinking / troubleshooting skills.Ability to read and interpret blueprints.Flexible – willingness to work off-shifts and weekends to accomplish goals.Positive attitude with the ability to support the Company’s goals and mission.Must use excellent ethical business practices and good judgment in dealings.High safety focus with the desire to maintain a safe work environment in an industrial setting.A commitment to continuous improvement.Ability to work collaboratively to solve problems and remain open to try new ways of doing things.Ability to focus on highly detailed tasks to ensure accuracy.

What You’ll Love About SKF

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays.

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health.

Diversity in the Workplace. At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement, and innovation.

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment. Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

Reports to: NPI Supervisor
